name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel 33" Dual Mount 3-Level Workstation Sink with Faucet, Waterfall and Glass Rinser
shortDescription: The MultiSINK Pro Chef is a 3-level workstation sink designed for total kitchen freedom. Tailor-made accessories including an auxiliary sliding sink bamboo cutting board, colander, and roll-up grids support seamless prep, rinse, and dry. The side-mounted control center powers a 3-function Chef faucet and the Integrated Pivoting WaterWALL for wide-range rinsing. A rotary glass washer and deck-mounted drying station add precision and performance. Dual-mount installation and IAPMO certification ensure lasting quality and universal fit.

features.text: 3-Level All-in-One 33 in. Workstation MultiSINK Precision Rail System: Supports multiple working levels for unmatched control
Premium Custom-Fit Accessories Move Freely Across All 3 Levels for Flexible Prep, Rinse & Dry
Pivoting WaterWALL minimizes splashes and delivers a Waterfall Rinse that sweeps over produce, dishes & cookware
3-Function Stainless Steel Pull Down Chef Faucet with Boost Blade Power Wash. Side mounted control, all-in-one
Built-In Glass Washing Station with Tornado-Spin Action Washer Deep-Cleans Every Glass and even Tall Flute to a Flawless Shine
Innovative On-Deck Drying Stations Turn Sink Deck into Space-Maximizing Dry Zones that Keep Counters Clear
